MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF EMPG HOLDINGS LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 23 rd OCTOBER 2018 
 
 Agenda 1 
 
 ADVANCEMENT OF LOAN TO ZAMEEN DEVELOPMENTS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to advance a loan in the principal amount of AED 3,000,000 to Zameen Developments (Private) Limited (“ Zameen ”). The Board unanimously nominated Mark Nosworthy to discuss, negotiate and ac cept this proposal . 
 
 Agenda 2 
 
 EQUITY INVESTMENT IN ZAMEEN DEVELOPMENTS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to subscribe to ordinary shares of Zameen against an investment of AED 1,000,000, subject to applicable bank charges. The Board unanimously nominated Mark Nosworthy to discuss, neg otiate and accept this proposal . 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matters in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company advance a loan in the principal amount of AED 3 million to Zameen. 
 Resolved further by the Board that the Company subscribe to ordinary shares of Zameen against an investment of AED 1,000,000. 
 Resolved further by the Board that Mark Nosworthy is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transactions. 
 
 
 _________________________________ 
 Mark Nosworthy 
 Company Secretary
